pairs.subject: agent-cli-transport
pairs.evidence: scripts/onboard-ui/engine.mjs:1387 The engine drops the stream-json result frame without reading its is_error/subtype, so the tool's own failure classification never reaches the studio as a typed value. Only a non-zero exit plus a stderr tail is reported.

techniques.evidence: scripts/onboard-ui/engine.mjs:1387 The result envelope's error subtype is ignored. Separately, the stdin write at line 1321 is wrapped in try/catch but has no stdin 'error' listener, so an EPIPE after a quick child exit arrives as an unhandled stream event.

scripts/onboard-ui/engine.mjs:1239 start() spawns straight away with no version check and no zero-token auth check (e.g. `auth status`). A missing or logged-out CLI shows up only as a spawn error or exit code.

scripts/onboard-ui/engine.mjs:54 The flag behaviour is recorded only as a version in a comment. buildArgs hardcodes the flags and nothing compares the installed version to the measured one, unlike claude_cli.py's VERIFIED_CLI_VERSION drift check.
scripts/onboard-ui/engine.mjs:239 Every ANTHROPIC_*_KEY/AUTH_TOKEN is removed at the single spawn door (sanitizeEnv), so the session runs on the subscription.

scripts/onboard-ui/engine.mjs:1246 assertEnforcement re-checks the argv and the settings file the child will actually load (ask-hook present, no bypass tokens) and refuses to start if either is wrong.

scripts/onboard-ui/engine.mjs:1406 A tripwire compares the tool_use blocks the child reports with the can_use_tool requests it sent, so the stance is checked against what the child did, not assumed from the host's intent.

scripts/onboard-ui/engine.mjs:1655 Approvals are routed over the permission-prompt-tool stdio channel to studio cards. On stop or exit, failPending turns every unanswered request into a deny, and unknown control subtypes get an error response.

scripts/onboard-ui/engine.mjs:1517 The session is attended and every shell call is routed to the host for a decision, so the technique's own 'person within reach' exclusion applies. No per-call allow file is used.
scripts/onboard-ui/engine.mjs:1330 Each run starts a fresh session. No thread id is stored or resumed.
scripts/onboard-ui/engine.mjs:1282 The installer is the agent session itself, so there is no model verdict for a deterministic floor to replace. Absence is reported loudly rather than imitated.

pairs.subject: agent-cli-transport
pairs.evidence: pipeline/jobfit/tests/test_claude_cli.py:195 The Claude CLI transport tests pin the zero-token auth probe, the key strip, the closed mode vocabulary, the typed error subtype, the version-drift check against the verified pin, and the refuse-before-spawn rungs, so a regression in any of these fails the gated suite.

techniques.evidence: pipeline/jobfit/tests/test_claude_cli.py:195 The probe runs `auth status --json` (zero tokens). Line 197 asserts it runs under the same key-stripped env as the real call.
pipeline/jobfit/tests/test_claude_cli.py:261 Asserts the key is stripped by default. test_claude_cli_terms.py BillingLaneTest pins the per-lane strip/keep direction.
pipeline/jobfit/tests/test_claude_cli.py:73 The tool's own error subtype reaches the caller as a value. Empty, non-JSON and over-cap stdout are pinned as named failures.

pipeline/jobfit/tests/test_claude_cli.py:146 repo_scan can only be built through with_repo_access. Stance kwargs such as acceptEdits are refused at construction, and the scanned repo's own settings are not loaded.
pipeline/jobfit/tests/test_claude_cli.py:290 A drift from VERIFIED_CLI_VERSION logs a warning once and never fails the call. The flag rows in claude_cli.py carry verification dates.
pipeline/jobfit/tests/test_claude_cli.py:245 Each descent has a named reason (offline_policy before not_installed). The terms veto refuses before any spawn (test_claude_cli_terms.py:143).
pipeline/jobfit/tests/test_claude_cli.py:141 The provider is a batch, unattended print-mode transport with a closed mode vocabulary, so there is no person to route approvals to.
pipeline/jobfit/tests/test_claude_cli.py:153 There is no edit seam (MODES = generate/repo_scan/web_research) and write-capable stances are refused, so no edit-session shell grants exist to derive.
pipeline/jobfit/tests/test_claude_cli.py:304 Every call is a fresh one-shot run. claude_cli.py has no resume path.
